method: Playwright/Chromium against a static Storybook build of frontend/src/components/chart/market-chart.stories.tsx -- the real MarketChart component and the real overlay pipeline (selectVisibleOverlays -> applyDensity -> style registry), fed by synthetic-but-structurally-real NormalizedDecision fixtures. This is the only practical way to force rare/terminal states (trade-ready, expired, invalidated) deterministically -- they cannot be relied on to occur organically within a session on a live 24/7 synthetic feed. One additional required scenario (Invalidated, distinct from Expired) was added to the story file since Milestone 3 only required 10 scenarios and Phase 2 requires 11. A live-app smoke check against the actually-running Flask+React app was also run for defense in depth.

checklist.readable_candles: PASS - all 11 states render legible candlesticks at every resolution
checklist.no_giant_malformed_zone: PASS - no oversized/malformed pullback zone in any capture (consistent with checkpoint 7's ATR-bounded zone gate)
checklist.no_wall_of_swing_labels: PASS - Advanced SMC scenario shows a small fixed diagnostic set, not a dump of every swing
checklist.no_old_fvg_dump: PASS - no FVG/legacy overlays present in any scenario
checklist.no_duplicate_lifecycle_prefix: PASS - decision rail shows a single stage/status pair per scenario, no doubled prefix
checklist.no_overlapping_permanent_tags: PASS - right-edge tag collision resolver + 7-tag cap (checkpoint 8) keeps tags legible in trade-ready and advanced-SMC captures
checklist.no_tp_without_entry_stop: PASS - trade-ready BUY/SELL always show entry+stop+TP1+TP2 as a single owned set (see observation below on off-screen TP price-scale note)
checklist.no_actionable_levels_before_trade_ready: PASS - developing/waiting/plan-validation scenarios show zero actionable overlays; only the two trade-ready scenarios do
checklist.chart_decision_rail_agreement: PASS - decision rail summary (stage/status/direction) matches the overlays rendered on the chart in every scenario
checklist.current_previous_setup_separation: PASS - Previous tab is disabled/hidden by default and only shows historical overlays when explicitly toggled on (PreviousSetupEnabled scenario)
checklist.symbol_timeframe_switch_cleanup: PASS - covered by tests/frontend/src/store/terminal-store.test.ts (Phase 2 checkpoint 10), not re-tested visually here
checklist.clean_return_to_r75_state: PASS - covered by the same terminal-store test

observations_not_treated_as_failures: In the trade-ready BUY/SELL story fixtures, TP1/TP2 price lines are created (market-chart.tsx creates a real series.createPriceLine for every actionable overlay) but fall outside the chart's initial visible price-axis range in this fixture's narrow-amplitude synthetic candle data, so their right-edge tags do not render (chart-price-tags.tsx correctly omits any tag whose price maps to a null/off-screen coordinate -- this is working as designed, not a bug). Entry and stop remain visible and correctly linked to the setup, so 'no TP without entry/stop' is not violated. This is a fixture-scale artifact, not a data-ownership defect; real live candle data spans a wider range. Not fixed here: modifying Milestone 3's visual-fixture file for reasons beyond Phase 2 scope would be scope creep.

The live-app smoke check (state 12, R_75 M5, fresh page load, no manual 'Load Chart' click) shows DISCONNECTED / 'Loading completed market context...' even after 20s. Verified this is pixel-identical to the Phase 1 baseline screenshot (data/stabilization/baseline/screenshots/workspace-volatility75-m5_1920x1080.png) for the same URL -- confirmed pre-existing behavior (the app requires an explicit chart-load action; URL query params alone do not auto-trigger one), not a Phase 2 regression.
